actual_diff_reviewed.identity_contract: After a strictly old completed prefix, only the exact context.first_layer with a parsed TimeStart within inclusive±2s confirms the resume anchor. Temperature0 or unfinished status supplies identity metadata only, never a measurement/key/actionable token.
actual_diff_reviewed.unset_finish_contract: Only blank or exact DateTime.MinValue, parsed through the existing four formats, is an allowed unset finish. Nonzero MinValue fractions, other ancient dates, arbitrary text and unsupported timestamp spellings do not qualify.
actual_diff_reviewed.validation: Numeric/range and -1 guards run before metadata acceptance. Valid start/finish chronology is checked even at temperature0. Recorded anchor start and known finish reject conflicting duplicate timestamps. No layer+1 allowance or47-second tolerance was added.
actual_diff_reviewed.baseline_contract: The resume-baseline latch survives separate reads, partial tails and1MiB parser chunks. It suppresses is_new for the whole first usable batch and is consumed only with a valid sample and complete stable file token. Only a following genuinely new eligible record can become actionable.
actual_diff_reviewed.reset_contract: Job change, replacement, truncation or consumed-prefix rewrite clears anchor/baseline state through _clear_file. Existing generation, exact CSV selection, two-read content/hash, bounds, freshness, duplicate/reverse-layer and Save verification paths remain.
actual_diff_reviewed.other_components: Fourteen algorithm/UI/Excel/native/persistence/image/config components are byte-identical to released base. Control-only UI, editableBL13, image mapping, chart-only terminal events and full-history CSV archival are unchanged.
